title: Coupling ozone-based AOPs with DLLME for simultaneous determination of trace free antimony and total antimony in surface water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16734-16741
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00432B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaofang Sun, Chuanbin Zhang, Youwen Pan, Haiyang Mei, Jiawen Song, Mengfei Zhou
A novel determination method based on UV/O3 synergistic oxidation-malachite green-dispersive liquid–liquid microextraction (DLLME)-spectrophotometry can achieve the enrichment of trace amount of antimony in water and high-precision detection.
